resources.string: Floating dictation bubble: you speak, Murmure writes.

Murmure uses this service only to detect when a text field is active, in order to show its floating dictation bubble, and to insert the text you dictated into that field. Password and sensitive fields are ignored. Nothing read on screen is stored or sent anywhere: transcription happens entirely on your phone.
Murmure: tap to stop, long press to cancel
Tap the bubble again to stop.
